ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. That Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the RS-2 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District
symbols as shown on Map Number 12-K in the area generally bounded by:

       South Archer Avenue; South Keating Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to South
       Archer Avenue; and a line 117 feet west of South Keating Avenue as measured along the
       south right-of-way line and perpendicular to South Archer Avenue

to those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Common Address: 5345-5353 South Archer Avenue




                                                                  Silvana Tabares
                                                                  Alderman, 23rd Ward
